caption: ENGLISH CHIEFS AT SURAT, 1613-1633.
raw_text: Left in charge of the factory at Best's departure in January, 1613. Died at Nariād, October 4, 1615.

caption: ENGLISH CHIEFS AT SURAT, 1613-1633.
raw_text: Appointed Agent, February 18, 1616. Title changed to President in 1618 or 1619. Handed over charge i nApril, 1621.

caption: ENGLISH CHIEFS AT SURAT, 1613-1633.
raw_text: Became President in April, 1621. Sailed for England, February 15, 1625.

caption: ENGLISH CHIEFS AT SURAT, 1613-1633.
raw_text: Arrived as President, March 8, 1625. Sailed for England in April, 1628.

caption: ENGLISH CHIEFS AT SURAT, 1613-1633.
raw_text: Elected President, April 13, 1628. Sailed for England, April 14, 1630.

caption: ENGLISH CHIEFS AT SURAT, 1613-1633.
raw_text: Arrived from England as President, September 26, 1630. Died November 7, 1631.

caption: ENGLISH CHIEFS AT SURAT, 1613-1633.
raw_text: Elected President, December 29, 1631. Died towards the end of 1633.
